verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no open-source or self-hostable distribution of the LaunchDarkly flag platform itself. The open-source Relay Proxy runs on your own infrastructure, but it only proxies the LaunchDarkly streaming API to clients, so the hosted service remains the control plane. That makes it an adjacent component, not a self-hosted platform. The federal docs describe a FedRAMP-compliant instance, not a deployment on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure
